messages:
Lauren: Pushed a new draft of the launch blog to Drive — link: https://drive.redwood/launch_v2. Need quick alignment on benchmark wording, hero CTA, and the webhook field for HubSpot. Can folks skim and flag blockers?
Tom (Analytics): looked at the benchmark section. The headline claim currently says "~40% faster token latency" which reads too absolute. Recommend: "up to 40% lower p50 token latency on our internal test harness; results vary by workload." Also add a 1-sentence methodology note.
Maya (Growth): Agree with Tom. Also, we need explicit UTMs for organic vs sponsored so reporting maps cleanly.
Lauren: Proposed UTMs in the doc: 
``nutm_source=redwood_blog
utm_medium=organic
utm_campaign=launch_spring24
utm_content=hero_cta
```
For paid: utm_medium=paid and utm_content=paid_hero_cta.
Priya (Growth): Please add a CSV mapping for HubSpot import with workflow names and a first_touch column. Example in the doc: 
``npage,utm_campaign,hs_workflow,registration_flow,first_touch
/blog/launch,launch_spring24,ws_blog_to_webinar,standard,blog
/blog/launch,launch_spring24,ws_blog_to_webinar,paid,blog
```
Evan (Sales Ops): We need the webhook to include first_touch=blog and utm_campaign so SDRs can see attribution. Can you add first_touch to the payload?
Lauren: Yep I'll add the webhook mapping and paste the webhook sample in the notes.
Sam (Design): Uploaded two hero options — product shot and a simplified benchmark graphic (heatmap). Which should go in the hero vs inline?
Maya (Growth): Product shot for hero (better CTR), heatmap inline next to the benchmark paragraph. Also need a short social headline (<= 60 chars).
Lauren: Draft headline options in the doc: 1) "Ship LLM features with consistent performance" 2) "Run LLMs that behave in production" 3) "Inference engineered for reliability and cost" Which resonates?
Priya (Growth): #1 is developer-forward and concise. For social card use: "Predictable LLM inference" (short).
Tom (Analytics): Legal check on comparison phrasing — Jen?
Jen (Legal): The proposed benchmark sentence Tom suggested is acceptable if we: 1) avoid naming competitors, 2) include the methodology blurb, and 3) keep the claim anchored to our internal harness. Also please attach raw CSV results in the Drive appendix.
Lauren: Will attach raw CSV and a one-line methodology: "P50 token latency measured on our 8k-context internal harness using a mixed-production trace; see appendix for raw results."
Evan (Sales Ops): Confirming HubSpot workflow names and that the webhook will pass first_touch. Once done I can wire lead routing and the SDR view.
Lauren: Added the CSV and webhook snippet to the doc. Sample webhook body we plan to send: 
``n{
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "first_touch": "blog",
  "utm_campaign": "launch_spring24"
}
```
Maya (Growth): Webinar cadence — we have two slots: Tue May 3 10am PT (Americas) and Wed May 4 4pm CET (EMEA). Put the May 3 slot in the hero CTA; show the alternate slot in the modal.
Sam (Design): I'll export hero PNGs and mobile variants. ETA: Friday 2pm PT.
Lauren: Can Growth confirm CTA wording? Current options: "Register" vs "Reserve your seat" vs "Save a spot".
Priya (Growth): Test shows "Reserve your seat" lifts intent ~8%. Use that on hero + modal. For paid creative we can A/B "Save a spot" in one ad set.
Tom (Analytics): Small ask — include a short line under the benchmark chart that says "See appendix for methodology and raw numbers" so we don’t over-index on the headline.
Lauren: Done. I appended the line and attached raw numbers.
Jen (Legal): Final pass: copy + benchmark OK with the included methodology and appendix. Keep the raw data in Drive for audit.
Evan (Sales Ops): Once Sam drops final assets and Lauren updates the webhook mapping, I will create the HubSpot workflows and ensure first_touch lands on lead records.
Lauren: Final deliverables checklist: 1) hero image (Sam) 2) CTA text updated to "Reserve your seat" (done) 3) UTMs + HubSpot CSV (in doc) 4) webhook payload with first_touch (done) 5) raw benchmark CSV + methodology (attached). Target publish: Thu May 9 10am PT.
Sam (Design): Confirmed — will hand off images and responsive slices by Friday 2pm PT.
Maya (Growth): I'll run a smoke test of the registration flow on Monday and post screenshots.
Lauren: Great — thanks everyone. If no objections I will lock the draft tomorrow morning and schedule the publish. :party_popper:
